{{Quote|The Separatists must be planning a sneak attack on Maarka!|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="Milk Run to Maarka!" />}}
'''Maarka''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Perkell sector/Legends|Perkell sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was the site of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Maarka Republic base|base]]. While on a mission to deliver a [[Datafile/Legends|data file]] with important intelligence for the Republic base on Maarka, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] was [[Skirmish in unidentified asteroid field (Maarka)|ambushed]] by six [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] in an [[Unidentified asteroid field (Maarka)|asteroid field]] near the planet.<ref name="Milk Run to Maarka!" />
